title: Zam Wesell
franchise: Star Wars: Attack of the Clones
description: Zam Wesell was a mysterious shape-shifting assassin, a Clawdite hailing from the planet Zolan. She was hired by Jango Fett to assassinate Senator Padmé Amidala from Naboo. After a planted explosive aboard her starship killed only the Senator's decoy, Zam attacked Padmé's apartment poisoning her with deadly kouhuns. However, the Jedi were protecting Padmé and hunted the shape-shifter down.
